phases.goal: Stabilize the largest bowl as the bottom support.
phases.name: set_largest_bowl
phases.verify: Largest bowl is upright and stable.

phases.goal: Place the middle bowl on or in the largest bowl.
phases.name: place_middle_bowl

phases.goal: Place the smallest bowl on the two-bowl stack.
phases.name: place_smallest_bowl
phases.verify: Three bowls are stacked largest to smallest.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Largest bowl is the support first.
Middle bowl is placed on the largest.
Smallest bowl is placed last on the stack.

roles.manipulated_order: largest bowl bottom, middle bowl, smallest bowl top
roles.protected: lower bowls remain stable while upper bowl is placed
roles.target_stack: bowls nested or stacked largest to smallest

task_language: Position the glazed bowl with curved sides one on top of the other largest to smallest.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50); 3:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50); 4:release(arm=right). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid releasing a tilted bowl onto the stack; verify each held bowl is upright and centered while preserving the larger bowls below it.
